## 3D algorithm enhancements 3D algorithm enhancements 

### Volume rendering Volume rendering 

A new VolR algorithm creates a more realistic image. The system assesses the hardware and applies one of A new VolR algorithm creates a more realistic image. The system assesses the hardware and applies one of two modes to set the default. The default is the best performance/quality ratio and interactivity level. two modes to set the default. The default is the best performance/quality ratio and interactivity level. 

| Non-enhanced-VolR  | Delivers high image rendition performance. You cannot control the level of the Fast or Slow qualities.  |
| --- | --- |
| Enhanced-VolR  | Delivers high image quality. You can control the quality/performance ratio to set the interactivity level to High, Normal, or Low.  |

You can manually select enhanced-VolR mode or non-enhanced-VolR mode. You can manually select enhanced-VoIR mode or non-enhanced-VolR mode. 

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

1. 1\. Click the drop-down menu for Click the drop-down menu for **Edit VolR Protocol**Edit VoIR Protocol - . 
2. 2\. Select or deselect Select or deselect **Enhanced VolR**Enhanced VolR. . 
3. 3\. If If **Enhanced VolR**Enhanced VolR is selected, select is selected, select **High**High, , **Normal**Normal, , or or **Low**Low. . Your selection overrides the system default selection. Choose the mode based on your workstation. Your selection overrides the system default selection. Choose the mode based on your workstation. 

| **Workstation**  | **Mode**  |
| --- | --- |
| High-end  | Enhanced-VolR  |
| Standard  | Enhanced-VolR  |
| Low-end  | Non-enhanced-VolR  |

### Automatic vessel segmentation Automatic vessel segmentation 

Use the protocol to automatically segment major arteries and generate minor arteries accessible through the Use the protocol to automatically segment major arteries and generate minor arteries accessible through the reference 2D/3D images. reference 2D/3D images. 

_Important: Cage removal is mandatory for cardiac scans. Bone removal is optional but recommended for body scans._ Important: Cage removal is mandatory for cardiac scans. Bone removal is optional but recommended for body scans. 

1. 1\. Click Click **New Vessel**New Vessel \> automatic protocol (\> automatic protocol (Coronary **Coronary Tree**Tree or or **Torso/Runoff**Torso/Runoff). ). The algorithm segments the major vessels and displays the vessels on the 3D image. The layout The algorithm segments the major vessels and displays the vessels on the 3D image.
